baseline_models.focus_anchor: The conditional repeats the support root at words 5 and 7, reversing human and divine agency around the divine name.
baseline_models.mechanism: The first act makes the worshiped claim effective in human action; the answering act supplies aid and public efficacy. The mirrored verb creates reciprocity without making the agents equal.

activation_trace.role: Aid that brings a party into ascendancy supplies both sides of the mirrored action: believers enact support and God grants effective support.
The worship-directed sense locates the human act in service to the divine claim rather than repair of a divine deficiency.

changed_reading.before: A general promise that piety will be rewarded.
changed_reading.after: A reciprocal enactment: make God's claim operative and visible, and divine aid makes the supporters effective.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The result clause joins causative stabilization at word 8 directly to plural feet at word 9.
baseline_models.mechanism: Divine aid is transmitted into a durable bodily base. Holding position and moving forward remain simultaneous possibilities, so firmness is controlled mobility rather than immobility.

activation_trace.role: Causative strengthening supplies the transfer from promised aid to an acquired capacity to remain steady.
The anatomical foot keeps the result concrete, load-bearing, and vulnerable to displacement.
Forward movement prevents steadiness from collapsing into merely standing still.

changed_reading.before: God grants an unspecified inner steadfastness.
changed_reading.after: God's aid reaches the supporters as usable footing: they can bear pressure, hold, and continue forward.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The addressees are named by belief at word 3 before support is demanded and courage-bearing feet conclude the promise.
baseline_models.mechanism: Settled trust becomes public action. Divine response steadies judgment and converts inward confidence into the courage to approach rather than withdraw.

activation_trace.role: Security and trust supply the affective starting condition from which risky support becomes possible.
Assent trusted by the heart makes the address a demand that conviction become conduct.
Mental and verbal composure supplies the interior stabilization behind outward action.
Bold approach gives the settled interior state a directional and courageous expression.

changed_reading.before: Belief and victory are separate religious ideas.
changed_reading.after: The verse describes a conversion chain from trusted conviction, through service, into divinely steadied courage.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The final two roots can carry confirmation and an established prior standing in addition to literal bodily firmness.
baseline_models.mechanism: The result may preserve or ratify a supporter’s forward standing, prior contribution, or earned position. This coexists with, but does not replace, the bodily reading.

activation_trace.role: Confirmation and proof activate a result in which something becomes established as valid, not only physically stable.
Prior standing, precedence, or credited contribution supplies the object that may be confirmed and preserved.

changed_reading.before: Only the supporters' physical balance is secured.
changed_reading.after: Their standing and forward contribution may also be made durable and recognizable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier counterfactual says God could vindicate directly, then places people in an ordeal through one another. Human support is therefore commissioned participation in a proving arena, not supplementation of inadequate divine power.

activation_trace.role: The mirrored aid remains the focus mechanism whose apparent symmetry needs contextual qualification.
Self-vindication after wrong supplies the divine action explicitly presented as possible without human help.
An ordeal that makes condition visible turns human encounter into the chosen medium of participation and disclosure.

structural_cues: 47:4 places direct divine vindication in a counterfactual and immediately contrasts it with testing some people through others.
The same support root reappears in 47:7 as a human condition followed by a divine response.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies divine capacity for direct vindication and an instead-like testing relation; I infer that the test explains why human support matters despite that capacity. A narrower alternative is that 47:4 only supplies battlefield background.

changed_reading.before: Humans help God, then God repays the favor.
changed_reading.after: God needs no reinforcement; humans are admitted into the test through which divine aid becomes operative in their action and character.

context_deltas.mechanism: Path, guidance, travel, loss of direction, and deliberate retreat build a movement system around the focus feet. Stabilization means maintaining a true trajectory under forces that divert or reverse, not remaining fixed at one coordinate.

activation_trace.role: Durability supplies continuity across a route rather than a single instant of balance.
Advance gives the stable feet a forward vector.
A traversable extended route supplies the larger space in which footing matters.
Loss of guidance and aim supplies the trajectory-level opposite of stabilized advance.
Gentle direction toward a route makes stability an ongoing guided movement.
Actual going through the land keeps the path frame embodied rather than purely doctrinal.
Return toward a former location supplies reversal as the danger to forward stability.
Turning one's back makes the reversal volitional and bodily.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from obstruction and misdirection in 47:1 to guidance in 47:5, travel in 47:10, and retreat after guidance in 47:25.
The focus ends on plural feet rather than an abstract noun for resolve.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated route, guidance, travel, and retreat cues; I infer that they form a directional frame for the focus feet. Literal steadiness in combat remains a live alternative rather than being displaced.

changed_reading.before: God keeps believers from falling during a confrontation.
changed_reading.after: God preserves their ability to keep moving in the disclosed direction without being diverted, lost, or turned back.

context_deltas.mechanism: The reciprocal conditional sits inside an unequal patronage relation. The believers enact loyalty and aid, while God is their protecting patron; the opposing side has no patron and cannot diminish God.

activation_trace.role: Mutual-looking aid provides the relation that patronage makes explicitly asymmetric.
The divine object of service fixes the vertical direction of the human commitment.
Protective allegiance names the social relation behind divine support and its absence for the opposing side.
The absence of any effective helper supplies the negative counterpart to the focus promise.
Denial of loss or injury to God blocks a reading in which human failure damages divine capacity.

structural_cues: 47:11 balances God as patron of believers against the repeated absence of a patron for rejecters.
47:32 explicitly denies that opposition can harm God while saying the opponents' works will fail.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies patronage, helperlessness, and divine invulnerability; I infer that these qualify the focus reciprocity as covenantal allegiance under a protecting patron. Direct military assistance remains a compatible but narrower realization.

changed_reading.before: The two acts of support form a symmetrical exchange between comparable parties.
changed_reading.after: Human aid is loyal alignment within divine patronage; the answering support protects and empowers the dependent party.

context_deltas.mechanism: A requested command becomes frightening when fighting is named; diseased hearts lose motion under a deathlike gaze, while obedience, resolved purpose, and truthfulness describe the alternative transition into action. Stabilized feet are the bodily completion of professed belief.

activation_trace.role: Heart-trusted assent supplies the profession that must survive contact with a costly command.
Composure of heart, reason, and speech supplies the interior capacity needed at the decision point.
Courageous approach converts inner composure into executed movement.
Mutual combat supplies the concrete pressure under which verbal desire for instruction is tested.
Impairment and curtailed motion materialize the failure to move from hearing into action.
Overwhelmed awareness supplies the death-facing paralysis against which composure is needed.
Willing compliance supplies the first non-paralyzed response.
Purpose that persists along a route joins decision to forward movement.
Fulfilling a declared commitment makes bodily follow-through the test of truthfulness.

structural_cues: 47:20 moves from asking for revelation to a deathlike response when a decisive fighting command arrives.
47:21 answers with obedience, fitting speech, resolved action, and truthfulness toward God.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies profession, fear-induced impairment, obedience, resolve, and fulfilled truth; I infer a causal passage from speech to embodied execution. The sequence can also be read more generally as sincerity under any costly command.

changed_reading.before: Firm feet denote generic bravery or battlefield balance.
changed_reading.after: Firmness is the divinely enabled passage from trusted words through fear into resolved, truthful action.

context_deltas.mechanism: Clear evidence, responsive listening, and deliberation are contrasted with stamped or locked hearts. The focus stabilization can therefore include examined and evidenced firmness, while rigidity that prevents perception is its counterfeit.

activation_trace.role: Careful verification activates firmness reached through patient examination rather than reflex closure.
Evidence and confirmation make the resulting stance answerable to what has become clear.
Disclosure and clarity supply the epistemic ground on which a stable stance can rest.
Understanding that leads to response distinguishes receptive hearing from mere acoustic exposure.
A sealing imprint supplies the rival model of a fixed interior that can no longer receive.
The heart locates the contrast between stable discernment and closure in the same interior domain.
Considering consequences supplies the active inquiry that valid firmness can sustain.
Hard closure supplies the warning that immobility alone is not faithful stability.

structural_cues: 47:14 contrasts evident ground with beautified desire; 47:16 and 47:24 contrast exposure to words with sealed or locked reception.
The focus uses causative stabilization, leaving room for a process that produces warranted firmness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies evidence, understanding, deliberation, sealing, and locking; I infer that this contrast qualifies what kind of firmness 47:7 promises. The more direct alternative is moral resolve with no epistemic coloring.

changed_reading.before: Being firm means becoming unchangeably fixed.
changed_reading.after: Divine firmness can be receptive, examined, and evidential; the locked heart is rigid but not truly stabilized.

context_deltas.mechanism: Testing brings striving, patience, and reports into manifest knowledge. Divine stabilization need not bypass pressure; it can be the capacity that becomes observable and confirmed through pressure.

activation_trace.role: Proof and confirmation activate firmness as a demonstrated condition rather than an invisible possession.
Granted strengthening keeps confirmation connected to divine enablement rather than self-production alone.
Repeated ordeal makes latent condition appear in conduct and reported outcome.
Disclosure to knowing supplies the endpoint of the testing process.
Exertion under difficulty supplies the load under which stable capacity becomes visible.
Restraint against collapse supplies the observable behavior nearest to firm footing.
Knowledge of an affair's interior makes the tested report a disclosure of what was otherwise hidden.

structural_cues: 47:31 repeats the testing verb around knowing the strivers and patient and testing their reports.
The focus promises stabilization before the later verse shows the community subjected to disclosure-producing pressure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies testing, knowing, exertion, patience, and reports; I infer experiential or public manifestation, not a claim that divine knowledge was previously deficient. A live alternative is that testing only evaluates a stability granted independently beforehand.

changed_reading.before: Divine aid removes or precedes the ordeal by simply installing stability.
changed_reading.after: Aid can operate within ordeal, making steadfast action both possible and demonstrably real under load.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah repeatedly makes work liable to loss, collapse, invalidation, or deprivation. That repetition activates the focus branches of confirmation and prior standing: support answered by God may preserve the efficacy and credited position of enacted work.

activation_trace.role: Ratification supplies a non-bodily way for the promised result to make action endure.
Prior standing and credited contribution supply what can be preserved rather than erased.
Making something lost supplies the first failure mode for human work.
Purposive action identifies the recurring human product whose efficacy is at stake.
Downward collapse supplies a second material image for work losing effect.
The repeated object confirms that the collapse concerns intended deeds, not only status.
Active invalidation makes preservation of efficacy an explicit responsibility.
The believer-addressed warning ties durable action to the same audience as the focus promise.
Loss that strips a rightful work supplies the direct negative that divine accompaniment denies.
The final assurance makes enacted work the item protected from diminution.

structural_cues: Lost or nullified works recur in 47:1, 47:4, 47:8-9, 47:28, and 47:32-33 before 47:35 denies that believers' works will be deprived.
The focus result can be read through two latent branches that concern confirmation and prior standing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a repeated work-loss versus work-preservation pattern; I infer a semantic bridge from that pattern to confirmation and prior standing in the focus roots. The literal feet reading remains stronger and may leave the work motif parallel rather than constitutive.

changed_reading.before: The promise protects bodies and morale during conflict.
changed_reading.after: It may also secure the efficacy, credit, and forward standing of faithful work against becoming lost or void.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing sequence specifies material expenditure in God's path, then states divine self-sufficiency, human need, self-directed harm in withholding, and replacement after turning away. Supporting God is participatory giving that forms and benefits the giver; it does not fill a divine lack or guarantee the current group an indispensable position.

activation_trace.role: The reciprocal support formula receives a concrete material mode while retaining its broader field of aid.
A granted standing becomes conditional participation rather than an irreplaceable entitlement.
Owned wealth supplies the resource whose demand raises the question of who needs whom.
Wealth leaving possession supplies a concrete form of human support.
The traversable route directs expenditure into the same mission-space as guided feet.
Repeated withholding supplies the refusal that appears to conserve resources but turns against the refuser.
The person's own self identifies the actual recipient of the loss caused by withholding.
Self-sufficiency explicitly removes divine need from the exchange.
Human lack reverses the apparent direction of benefit in the act of giving.
Turning away supplies the relational refusal that makes present participation revocable.
One party standing in place of another shows that the mission continues without dependence on its current bearers.

structural_cues: 47:38 echoes the focus conditional with a new condition: turning away leads to replacement by another people.
The closing rich-versus-poor antithesis places divine independence beside the call for human expenditure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies wealth, expenditure, withholding, self-harm, divine sufficiency, human need, and replacement; I infer that this retrospectively specifies one material mode and the asymmetry of 47:7. Martial, verbal, and social support remain live alternatives rather than being reduced to money.

changed_reading.before: Helping God suggests supplying resources that God otherwise lacks.
changed_reading.after: Giving into God's path admits people to a self-benefiting mission God does not need them to sustain; refusal forfeits their standing rather than weakening God.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it shifts from martial aid to an ecological material analogy, and water does not by itself mean firm footing. It remains anchored because the focus support inventory itself carries rain-relief and distant feeder-channel branches, while the context repeatedly displays flowing garden waters. Render it only as a secondary image of life-bearing succor, never as the lexical translation of the verse.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The repeated support root can carry rain-like relief and feeder channels, and the promised result still lands on literal feet.

activation_trace.role: Life-bearing precipitation turns aid into relief that restores capacity rather than only defeating an opponent.
A feeder arriving from afar at pooled water supplies a distributed-channel model for support.
Literal feet keep the ecological image accountable to the focus result.
Uninterrupted flow supplies the movement of relief through a sustaining environment.
A watercourse cut through land supplies the visible channel that activates the remote focus branch.
Repeated opened channels broaden the image from one stream to an abundant, sustaining network.

changed_reading.before: Support is imagined only as force applied against an enemy.
changed_reading.after: A contained material analogy sees reciprocal support as channels of service answered by life-giving relief that sustains a place from which people can move.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because plural feet become a collective base and later kinship language is not a direct gloss of the focus. It remains anchored in the focus strengthening and plural bodily footing, with severance and communal fissure supplying visible opposites. Render it as a social extension of the bodily mechanism, not as a replacement for individual steadfastness.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Causative strengthening terminates in plural feet, allowing the supported body to be heard as both many persons and one coordinated base.

activation_trace.role: Strengthening supplies the cohesion needed for many load-bearing members to function together.
Plural bodily supports provide the concrete base from which a communal extension can grow.
Broken connection supplies the social disassembly opposed to a strengthened base.
Kin relation identifies an actual human bond endangered by turning away.
A group split by opposition supplies the broader collective fracture that stabilized plurality resists.

changed_reading.before: Each individual is promised private steadiness.
changed_reading.after: Divine support may also hold a community's many points of contact together, while turning away appears as severance and factional fracture.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the immediate context uses the pressure root for importunity, while its barefoot and abraded-foot branches are remote material senses. It remains anchored because the focus explicitly names feet and the adjacent sequence asks about wealth and exhausting demand. Render it only as a word-image echo about non-extractive service, not as the direct sense of the context verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The promise strengthens literal feet, while the later demand sequence activates branches of baring and wearing down a foot.

activation_trace.role: Strengthening supplies the positive treatment of the supporters' bodily capacity.
The anatomical foot is the exact material contact point reactivated by the distant context branches.
A request for property supplies the extraction question that the following hypothetical intensifies.
Accumulated property makes the possible pressure materially costly.
Insistent pressing supplies the immediate demand mechanism in the context.
Loss of footwear materializes what an extracting demand could leave exposed at the focus endpoint.
Worn skin or hoof sharpens depletion into damage at the very organ God promises to steady.

changed_reading.before: Service may be imagined as a demand that consumes the supporters for divine benefit.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material echo, divine service does not strip and abrade its bearers' footing; the promise equips them even as the wealth sequence exposes their resistance to pressure.

strongest_changes: 47:4 turns apparent quid pro quo into delegated, test-bearing participation by agents God does not need for direct vindication.
The path-to-retreat sequence turns firm feet from static battle balance into guided directional fidelity.
Patronage and divine invulnerability make the reciprocal wording explicitly asymmetric.
Repeated work-loss language and 47:31 testing activate confirmation, preservation, and demonstrated steadiness alongside bodily firmness.
47:36-38 makes expenditure a concrete mode of support while divine self-sufficiency, human need, and replacement reverse the apparent direction of benefit.
summary.what_was_special: The same short focus clause acted as a switchboard: repeated support carried reciprocity, plural feet carried body and route, and stabilization opened interior, evidentiary, vocational, and communal readings. The context did not select one winner; it repeatedly changed which aspect of the focus mechanism was foregrounded.
remaining_uncertainties: The physical-foot and battlefield readings remain lexically strongest even when broader route and social models are active.
It is uncertain how far the prior-standing branch of the final root can color the plural body-part form without the repeated work motif doing most of the work.
The examination and proof branches of stabilization may be associative activations rather than direct senses of the causative verb here.
The irrigation, communal-base, and non-abraded-foot readings are deliberately contained cross-domain activations, not proposed translations.
